units.source_text: 那时，我已经是个大学生了，觉得自己和初到先生家时相比沉稳了些，而且同夫人也相当熟了。

en.t: By then, I was already a university student, and I felt I had grown somewhat calmer than when I first came to Sensei's house; I had also become quite familiar with his wife.

units.source_text: 和夫人相处，不觉得有任何拘束，我和夫人聊了很多，不过都是一般的闲聊，所以现在全忘了。

en.t: I felt no constraint at all when I was with his wife, and we talked about many things, but it was all ordinary small talk, so I have forgotten it completely now.

units.source_text: 我只记得其中谈到的一件事。

en.t: I remember only one thing that came up in those conversations.

units.source_text: 不过，在谈此事之前，我想先交代一下：

en.t: Before I speak of that matter, however, I should first explain one thing.

units.source_text: 先生是大学毕业，这我一开始就知道。

en.t: I had known from the beginning that Sensei was a university graduate.

units.source_text: 但是，先生赋闲在家，却是我回到东京后过了一些时候才知道的。

en.t: But I did not learn until some time after I returned to Tokyo that Sensei was idle at home.

units.source_text: 那时我就想，先生在家里怎么待得住呢？

en.t: At the time, I wondered how Sensei could bear staying at home like that.
